utility_use_case: In a research or media pipeline, repeated exports can quietly consume storage and make it harder to identify the authoritative asset. Run `bash duplicate-report.sh --root ./assets` before an archive or storage review to get a machine-readable inventory of byte-identical files and estimated redundant bytes. Researchers can retain the JSON report with the project record, then inspect each group and decide manually whether copies are safe to remove. The report is evidence for review, not an automatic cleanup decision.
